payload.content: A home-installation WordPress website helping homeowners navigate heating, climate and maintenance services before requesting advice or a quotation.
payload.description_1: Kervana serves homeowners who may know they have a heating or climate problem without knowing which technical service they need. Heating, cooling, maintenance and installation questions can overlap, especially when an existing system is involved.
payload.description_2: I structured Kervana around the type of question a homeowner is likely to bring to the site. Heating, climate solutions and maintenance each have a clear route, with supporting information introduced after the visitor has chosen the area that fits the situation.
